mapper.sql: s.id, s.sale_no, s.kind, s.status, s.store_id, s.terminal_id, s.shift_id, s.warehouse_id, s.member_id, s.orig_sale_id, s.business_date, s.sale_time, s.total_qty, s.list_amount, s.amount, s.order_discount, s.round_off, s.payable_amount, s.paid_amount, s.change_amount, s.promotion_id, s.promo_amount, s.points_earned, s.wms_doc_id, s.wms_doc_no, s.remark, s.void_by, s.void_time, s.void_reason, s.void_doc_id, s.dept_id, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_time, st.name AS store_name, t.name AS terminal_name, sh.shift_no, u.nickname AS cashier_name, m.member_code, m.name AS member_name, m.phone AS member_phone, o.sale_no AS orig_sale_no, pr.name AS promotion_name

LEFT JOIN store_info st ON st.id = s.store_id LEFT JOIN pos_terminal t ON t.id = s.terminal_id LEFT JOIN pos_shift sh ON sh.id = s.shift_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.create_by LEFT JOIN pos_member m ON m.id = s.member_id LEFT JOIN pos_sale o ON o.id = s.orig_sale_id LEFT JOIN pos_promotion pr ON pr.id = s.promotion_id
mapper.select:
SELECT , vu.nickname AS void_by_name FROM pos_sale s
LEFT JOIN sys_user vu ON vu.id = s.void_by WHERE s.id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM pos_sale WHERE sale_no = #{saleNo}
SELECT i.material_id AS "materialId", i.location_id AS "locationId", i.batch_no AS "batchNo", i.qty AS "qty" FROM wms_stock_doc_item i WHERE i.doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY i.id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'SALE' AND status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sale_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'SALE' AND status = 'COMPLETED' THEN payable_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sale_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'RETURN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS return_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'RETURN' THEN payable_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS return_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'VOIDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS void_count FROM pos_sale WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND business_date = #{date}

SELECT p.pay_method, p.account_id, a.name AS account_name, SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount > 0 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS receipt_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount < 0 THEN -p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS refund_amount, SUM(p.amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS pay_count FROM pos_payment p LEFT JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = p.account_id WHERE p.store_id = #{storeId} AND p.business_date = #{date} AND p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.sale_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.pay_method, p.account_id, a.name ORDER BY p.pay_method

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "shiftCount", COALESCE(SUM(expected_cash), 0) AS "expectedCash", COALESCE(SUM(counted_cash), 0) AS "countedCash", COALESCE(SUM(cash_diff), 0) AS "cashDiff" FROM pos_shift WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND business_date = #{date} AND status = 'CLOSED'

SELECT p.pay_method, p.account_id, a.name AS account_name, SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount > 0 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS receipt_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount < 0 THEN -p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS refund_amount, SUM(p.amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS pay_count FROM pos_payment p LEFT JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = p.account_id WHERE p.store_id = #{storeId} AND p.business_date = #{date} AND p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.topup_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.pay_method, p.account_id, a.name ORDER BY p.pay_method
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points_earned), 0) FROM pos_sale WHERE orig_sale_id = #{origSaleId} AND kind = 'RETURN'
SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 FROM pos_sale_item WHERE sale_id = #{saleId} AND returned_qty < input_qty
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM pos_sale WHERE orig_sale_id = #{origSaleId}
